title: Caribou Biosciences
summary: US clinical-stage company developing allogeneic CRISPR cell therapies.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Caribou Biosciences engineers donor-derived CAR-T and NK cell therapies using CRISPR, aiming for off-the-shelf treatments for cancer and autoimmune disease. Its chRDNA editing platform is designed to reduce chromosomal translocations. Clinical data and cash runway are critical.

Technology Exposure

  • Allogeneic CAR-T therapies
  • CRISPR cell engineering
  • Autoimmune and oncology programmes

What To Watch

  • Clinical data
  • Manufacturing scale
  • Funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
